title: The Summer of Rosewater Lane
author: Astrid Okonkwo
blurb: Jude Crane, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
